subject: [PATCH v5 5/7] sched/numa: scan PID-inactive VMAs for promotion

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed a low-impact corner case where prev_placement_scan_seq wasn't reset in mode 3. The change has minor impact and may not be worth the churn, but it's being considered for further review.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series enhances the vma scanning logic in the Linux kernel to promote hot slow-tier memory by bypassing a filter that suppresses faults for PID-inactive VMAs. The change allows inactive VMAs to receive promotion-only scans, which helps maintain tier residency and reduces CXL bandwidth utilization.
